item.title: Using Microsoft Graph and Powershell to Mine for Information - Stale Accounts and Licenses, (Thu, Aug 20th)
item.source: SANS Internet Storm Center, InfoCON: green
item.content:encoded: Microsoft Graph is a newer API that is meant to replace several others. OK, it's at version 2.3.9, so it's not all that new, but it's new enough that lots of folks (and commercial tools) aren't using it yet. It allows you to Get and Set info from/to M365, Entra Users and Entra managed machines for starters. Let's dig in!
